subject: Request: temporary headroom & overrun credit for FastCart launch
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@fastcart.ai>
To: Kimble Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary headroom & overrun credit for FastCart launch

Hi Kimberly,

Quick ask — we have a marketing-driven launch slated for next Tuesday that could spike embedding and generation traffic for a 36–48 hour window. Our product team estimates a 3–4x increase from baseline for that short period. Given the short notice, can Redwood provision a temporary headroom increase (rate-limit bump) and offer a limited overrun credit/true-up so we don't get throttled or face a large one-off bill?

Details:
- Estimated spike window: 2027-01-26 06:00 — 2027-01-27 18:00 PST
- Expected increase: ~3.5x token generation + heavier embedding calls
- Baseline monthly commit: 2.5M generation tokens / 50k embeddings

Attached is last quarter's usage for context. We can sign an amendment/PO if needed — procurement is standing by.

Tom Hsu
Head of Engineering
FastCart
attachments: FastCart_usage_report_Q4.csv (csv)
From: Kimble Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@fastcart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom & overrun credit for FastCart launch

Tom — appreciate the heads up and the usage report, that helps. We can absolutely support a short burst window; two immediate items: operational headroom (rate-limit / quota bump) and how we settle any overrun.

Provisional offer (subject to internal approval):
- Temporary headroom: +30% concurrency and +40% monthly quota cap for a 48-hour window (start/end times configurable)
- Overrun settlement: 30% credit applied to the net overrun invoice if FastCart signs an amendment committing to a 3-month blended minimum the following quarter OR pays a pre-authorized PO covering the estimated overrun amount within 7 days of invoice

I need to loop in Ben (pricing) and Laura (CS/procurement ops) to confirm the contract path and timelines. If you can confirm exact UTC times and whether embeddings vs. generation will be concentrated, that will help sizing.

Also copied a suggested SOW/Amendment template if procurement wants to move quickly.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
attachment stub: SOW_v1_FastCart.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimble Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@fastcart.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom & overrun credit for FastCart launch

Thanks Kim, Tom — I dug into last quarter's steady-state and the spike profile you sent. A few thoughts and a clean proposal to keep billing predictable: 

Proposal A (preferred — commercial balance):
- Operational: grant the +40% quota cap for a 48-hour window; enable prefix caching and an embedding batch suggestion to reduce token spend
- Financial: convert requested 30% overrun "credit" into a prorated volume rebate: if FastCart signs a 3-month minimum (commit = 110% of expected baseline for next quarter), Redwood will rebate 25% of net overrun spend for that 48-hour window in the following invoice cycle
- Rationale: rebate preserves unit economics and aligns incentives — FastCart avoids a one-off large charge, Redwood secures near-term ARR uplift

If procurement can't commit to a multi-month minimum, we can fallback to: 
Proposal B (pay-and-credit): FastCart prepays an estimated overrun PO; Redwood refunds 30% of the actual overrun spend after reconciliation.

Operational checklist: PO or amendment signed by EOD Friday to allow legal + provisioning. If PO timeline slips, we can still enable headroom but without the rebate.

Ben Carter
Sr. Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: 2027-01-21T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom & overrun credit for FastCart launch

Tom — can confirm Redwood can execute Proposal A pending a short amendment + PO. Operational notes and timeline: 

What we need from FastCart:
- Signed amendment (SOW_v1_FastCart.pdf) or explicit PO referencing deal FC-2027-Q1-42 by 2027-01-22 18:00 PST
- Confirmed spike start/end in UTC
- Point of contact for provisioning (API key owner + Slack channel preferred)

What Redwood will do on receipt:
- Legal: one-page amendment (no changes to T&Cs) — 24h turnaround
- Provisioning: enable headroom and apply caching rules 2h after receiving PO/ack
- Billing: run reconciliation the following invoice cycle and apply rebate/refund per chosen proposal

If procurement needs DocuSign, we can emit the amendment link as soon as the PO is in. I attached the SOW template for review.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
